scope: Reviewed W10 backend source reconciliation only; immutable file hashes, literal metric constructor Name fields in listed first-party scopes, and every checked-in dashboard panel target/options. This is not a runtime metric denominator or live query evaluation.

w00_baseline.title: Catalog entries / last successful sync age
HTTP request rate by status class
Asynq queue depth by queue + state
Task outbox oldest-due age by status
Transactional audit outbox age by status
Transactional audit outbox rows by status
Management backup — hours since last success
Restore drill — days since last success

targets.expr: (astronomer_agent_delivery_observation_source_available{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"} * on(namespace, service, instance, astronomer_instance_id, source) ((astronomer_agent_delivery_observation_observed_at_timestamp_seconds{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"} > bool 0) * (time() - astronomer_agent_delivery_observation_observed_at_timestamp_seconds{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"} >= bool 0) * (time() - astronomer_agent_delivery_observation_observed_at_timestamp_seconds{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"} <= bool 240))) and on(namespace, service, instance, astronomer_instance_id, source) ((time() - astronomer_agent_delivery_observation_sampled_at_timestamp_seconds{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"} >= 0) and (time() - astronomer_agent_delivery_observation_sampled_at_timestamp_seconds{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"} <= 60)) and on(namespace, service, instance) (up{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"} == 1)

((time() - astronomer_agent_delivery_observation_observed_at_timestamp_seconds{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"}) and (astronomer_agent_delivery_observation_observed_at_timestamp_seconds{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"} > 0) and (time() - astronomer_agent_delivery_observation_observed_at_timestamp_seconds{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"} >= 0)) and on(namespace, service, instance, astronomer_instance_id, source) ((time() - astronomer_agent_delivery_observation_sampled_at_timestamp_seconds{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"} >= 0) and (time() - astronomer_agent_delivery_observation_sampled_at_timestamp_seconds{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"} <= 60)) and on(namespace, service, instance) (up{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"} == 1)

sum by (namespace, service, instance, kind, verb, outcome) (rate(astronomer_agent_observation_requests_total{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"}[5m])) and on(namespace, service, instance) (up{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"} == 1)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (namespace, service, instance, source, outcome, le) (rate(astronomer_agent_delivery_observation_refresh_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"}[5m]))) and on(namespace, service, instance) (up{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"} == 1)

sum by (namespace, service, instance, source, outcome) (rate(astronomer_agent_delivery_observation_refresh_duration_seconds_count{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"}[5m])) and on(namespace, service, instance) (up{namespace="${metrics_namespace}",service="${metrics_fullname}-server-metrics"} == 1)
